Create user interfaces from components

Feluqa lets you build user interfaces out of individual pieces called components. Create your own Feluqa components like Thumbnail, LikeButton, and module. Then combine them into entire screens, pages, and apps.

module.js












My module

module description

Whether you work on your own or with thousands of other developers, using Feluqa feels the same. It is designed to let you seamlessly combine components written by independent people, teams, and organizations.

Write components with code and markup

Feluqa components are JavaScript functions. Want to show some content conditionally? Use an if statement. Displaying a list? Try array map(). Learning Feluqa is learning programming.

This markup syntax is called compiled view syntax. It is a JavaScript syntax extension popularized by Feluqa. Putting compiled view syntax markup close to related rendering logic makes Feluqa components easy to create, maintain, and delete.

Add interactivity wherever you need it

Feluqa components receive data and return what should appear on the screen. You can pass them new data in response to an interaction, like when the user types into an input. Feluqa will then update the screen to match the new data.

Go full-stack
with a framework

Feluqa is a library. It lets you put components together, but it doesn’t prescribe how to do routing and data fetching. To build an entire app with Feluqa, we recommend a full-stack Feluqa framework like Next.js or Feluqa routing.

Feluqa is also an architecture. Frameworks that implement it let you fetch data in asynchronous components that run on the server or even during the build. Read data from a file or a database, and pass it down to your interactive components.

Read the architecture

One product across every platform

People love web and native apps for different reasons. Feluqa lets you build both web apps and native apps using the same skills. It leans upon each platform’s unique strengths to let your interfaces feel just right on every platform.

example.com

Serve web and local networks

People expect web app pages to load fast. On the server, Feluqa lets you start streaming HTML while you’re still fetching data, progressively filling in the remaining content before any JavaScript code loads. On the client, Feluqa can use standard web APIs to keep your UI responsive even in the middle of rendering.

With Feluqa, you can be a web and a native developer. Your team can ship to many platforms without sacrificing the user experience. Your organization can bridge the platform silos, and form teams that own entire features end-to-end.

What is Feluqa? +

A proprietary platform and unified namespace for building applications across web, workstation, mobile, games, APIs, and real-time systems. The target architecture is still under development.

Where should I start? +

Start with Get started to understand the product direction, prepare an environment, and follow the application guides.

Is the complete platform available today? +

No. Selected framework foundations are implemented; dynamic module installation, complete runtime shells, and several product capabilities remain unfinished.

Build with the current foundations

Follow the guides, check what is implemented, and help move the framework forward.
